submittedClaim: Day 3: Tuesday - Gyeongbokgung Palace + Bukchon Village (Nov. 3) ... Closed: Tuesdays
officialFinding: Gyeongbokgung Palace AND the Royal Guard-Changing Ceremony are CLOSED EVERY TUESDAY (Nov 3 is not a public holiday).
recommendedAction: Swap Day 3 (Tuesday Nov 3) and Day 4 (Wednesday Nov 4 — Seongsu), OR visit Changdeokgung / Deoksugung Palace on Tuesday (closed Mondays, open Tuesdays).

item: N Seoul Tower Observatory & Namsan Cable Car Hours
officialFinding: AM/PM omitted & closing hours misstated! Official Observatory hours are Mon–Fri 10:00–22:30 (last entry 22:00), Sat–Sun 10:00–23:00; Official Cable Car hours are 10:00–23:00 daily (round-trip ticket sales close 22:30). Observatory (29,000 KRW) & Cable Car (15,000 KRW RT) are separate tickets.
recommendedAction: Enjoy full daytime or sunset/night skyline window; buy separate tickets or use Bus 01A/01B (1,500 KRW).

officialFinding: Nov 2, 2006 was a Thursday, whereas all 9 weekday/date pairs in the itinerary match Oct 31 – Nov 9, 2026 (Sun Nov 1 through Mon Nov 9). Official landmark spelling is Namsan / N Seoul Tower.
recommendedAction: Confirm 2026 travel year for hotel & KTX bookings; search 'Namsan Seoul Tower' or 'N Seoul Tower' in maps.

item: Bukchon Hanok Village Mandatory Tourist Curfew
submittedClaim: No visiting hours restriction noted in draft; paired with early Cafe Onion morning
officialFinding: Bukchon Red Zone restricts tourist entry strictly to 10:00–17:00 daily (entry prohibited 17:00–10:00 under Jongno-gu Special Management rules).
recommendedAction: Have breakfast at Cafe Onion Anguk (opens 07:00 weekdays) first, and enter Bukchon alleys only between 10:00 and 17:00.
officialSourceLabel: Visit Seoul Official — Bukchon Curfew Notice

item: Olive Young Myeongdong Operating Hours Conflict
officialFinding: Official Olive Young Myeongdong Global Town (53 Myeongdong-gil) opens 10:00–22:30 daily — NOT 8:00 AM to midnight.
recommendedAction: Shop between 10:00 and 22:30 and bring physical passports for instant VAT refund (>= 15,000 KRW).

item: AREX Fare ($7) & Airport Limousine Boarding Rule
submittedClaim: Arex (airport train) 45 min, $7 | Airport Limosine bus $13
officialFinding: Official AREX Express adult fare is 13,000 KRW (43 min T1 / 51 min T2 to Seoul Station only). Airport Limousine 6015 is 17,000 KRW directly to hotel block and requires buying a ticket at the ICN counter/kiosk before boarding.
recommendedAction: With luggage for 2 adults, take Limousine Bus 6015 direct to 'Lotte Hotel / IBIS Myeong-dong' (right next to Stanford Hotel Myeongdong).

item: Crystal Jade Shinsegae Main Store B1 Early Closing Time & Monthly Dept Store Closure
submittedClaim: Listed under evening/dinner after Night Market Exploration; Shinsegae B1 floor
officialFinding: Official Crystal Jade Shinsegae Main Store page confirms weekday hours are 10:30–20:00 (weekends 10:30–20:30), closing much earlier than night markets; Lotte & Shinsegae also close 1 Monday per month.
recommendedAction: Check Shinsegae's Nov 2026 monthly holiday notice, and eat at Crystal Jade B1 BEFORE 19:15 (then stroll night markets afterward).
officialSourceLabel: Crystal Jade Korea — Shinsegae Main Store

item: Dongdaemun Design Plaza (DDP) Description & Neighborhood Mix-Up
submittedClaim: Dongdaemun Design Plaza or 'DDP' - Industrial warehouses converted into flagship fashion pop-ups, & artisan bakeries
officialFinding: DDP (281 Eulji-ro, Jung-gu) is Zaha Hadid's futuristic curved museum/plaza in Dongdaemun (10:00–20:00). The 'converted industrial warehouses, fashion pop-ups & bakeries' description refers to Seongsu-dong itself (e.g., Daelim Changgo / Seongsu Yeonbang).
recommendedAction: Keep BOTH if desired — DDP is right on Subway Line 2 between Myeongdong and Seongsu!

item: Triple Duplicate Restaurant ('Chwihyang' = 'Favorite of Ikseon') & Gangdong Outlier
submittedClaim: Day 4: 'Uri Wang Galbitang located in Gangdong. Favorite of Ikseon-dong' | Day 6: '1. Chwihyang' & 'Restaurants: Favorite of Ikseon'
officialFinding: 'Chwihyang' (익선취향) and 'Favorite of Ikseon' refer to the same Ikseon-dong restaurant serving pork belly rosé pasta; 'Uri Wang Galbitang in Gangdong' is far outside Seongsu with unverified hours.
recommendedAction: Drop 'Favorite of Ikseon-dong' from Day 4, book/queue at Ikseon Chwihyang ONCE on Day 6, and verify any Seongsu dinner alternative locally.

item: Rain Report Branch Locations & Duplicate Visit
submittedClaim: Day 4: 'Rain Report Cafe' (Seongsu) & Day 6: 'Rain Report Cafe in Insadong'
officialFinding: VisitSeoul confirms 'Rain Report Rainbow' (33-7 Supyo-ro 28-gil, 10:30–20:30 daily) is located in Ikseon-dong (across the street from Insadong), whereas Seongsu's Rain Report Croissant has unconfirmed 2026 operating hours.
recommendedAction: Visit Rain Report Rainbow in Ikseon-dong on Day 6 (same lane as Jayeondo!) and skip duplicating on Day 4.
officialSourceLabel: Visit Seoul Official — Rain Report Rainbow

item: Unscheduled Days — Day 7 (Saturday: Itaewon) & Day 8 (Sunday: Empty)
officialFinding: Both weekend days have zero scheduled stops, while Days 2 & 4 are overloaded with 9–14 items (including an Itaewon BBQ stop on Day 2).
recommendedAction: Move Day 2's Itaewon dinner option ('Pig Restaurant 2') to Day 7 (Itaewon) and spread excess Day 2 / Day 4 stops calmly into Day 8!
